parameters.description: Expected output type. Default ``str``. Set to a Pydantic ``BaseModel`` subclass for structured output.

parameters.name: toolsets
parameters.description: List of pydantic-ai toolsets the agent can use (e.g. ``SQLToolset``, ``HookToolset``).

parameters.name: enable_tool_logging
parameters.description: When ``True`` (default), wraps each toolset in a ``LoggingToolset`` that logs tool calls with timing at INFO level and arguments at DEBUG level. Set to ``False`` to disable.

parameters.name: agent_params
parameters.description: Additional keyword arguments passed to the pydantic-ai ``Agent`` constructor (e.g. ``retries``, ``model_settings``).

parameters.name: durable
parameters.description: When ``True``, enables step-level caching of model responses and tool results for durable execution. On retry, cached steps are replayed instead of re-executing. Default ``False``. Requires ``[common.ai] durable_cache_path`` to be set. **HITL Review parameters** (requires the ``hitl_review`` plugin):

parameters.name: enable_hitl_review
parameters.description: When ``True``, the operator enters an iterative review loop after the first generation. A human reviewer can approve, reject, or request changes via the plugin's REST API at ``/hitl-review`` or through the **HITL Review** extra link on the task instance. Default ``False``.

parameters.name: max_hitl_iterations
parameters.description: Maximum outputs shown to the reviewer (1 = initial output). When the reviewer requests changes at iteration >= this limit, the task fails with ``HITLMaxIterationsError`` without calling the LLM. E.g. 5 allows changes at iterations 1–4. Default ``5``.

parameters.name: hitl_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum wall-clock time to wait for all review rounds combined. ``None`` means no timeout (the operator blocks until a terminal action).

parameters.name: hitl_poll_interval
parameters.description: Seconds between XCom polls while waiting for a human response. Default ``10``.

parameters.description: Allow PNG/JPG/PDF inputs as binary attachments. Default ``False``.

parameters.description: Maximum number of files to include from a prefix. Excess files are omitted and noted in the prompt. Default ``20``.

parameters.name: max_file_size_bytes
parameters.description: Maximum size of any single input file. Default ``5 MiB``.

parameters.name: max_total_size_bytes
parameters.description: Maximum cumulative size across all resolved files. Default ``20 MiB``.

parameters.name: max_text_chars
parameters.description: Maximum normalized text context passed to the LLM after sampling/truncation. Default ``100000``.

parameters.name: sample_rows
parameters.description: Maximum number of sampled rows or records included for CSV, Parquet, and Avro inputs. This limits structural preview depth, while ``max_file_size_bytes`` and ``max_total_size_bytes`` limit bytes read from storage and ``max_text_chars`` limits the final prompt text budget. Default ``10``.

parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.default:
Consider cross-system type equivalences:
- varchar(n) / text / string / TEXT may be compatible
- int / integer / int4 / INT32 are equivalent
- bigint / int8 / int64 / BIGINT are equivalent
- timestamp / timestamptz / TIMESTAMP_NTZ / datetime may differ in timezone handling
- numeric(p,s) / decimal(p,s) / NUMBER — check precision and scale
- boolean / bool / BOOLEAN / tinyint(1) — check semantic equivalence

Severity levels:
- critical: Will cause data loading failures or data loss (e.g., column missing in target, incompatible types)
- warning: May cause data quality issues (e.g., precision loss, timezone mismatch)
- info: Cosmetic differences that won't affect data loading (e.g., varchar length differences within safe range)
parameters.description: Instructions included in the LLM system prompt. Defaults to ``DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`` which contains cross-system type equivalences and severity definitions. Passing a value **replaces** the default system prompt
